title: Arista Networks Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: Q2 revenue was USD 3.036 billion, Q2 GAAP diluted EPS was USD 0.95, first-half operating cash flow was USD 2.7765 billion, and June 30 cash plus current marketable securities were USD 13.3433 billion; non-cancellable purchase commitments were USD 9.7 billion.
summary: The Q2 filing confirms the earnings, cash generation, balance-sheet liquidity, customer concentration and binding supply commitments used in the scenario-complete ANET review.
